'''June''' is the sixth month in the [[Wikipedia:Gregorian calendar|Gregorian calendar]]. It occurs in Wheel of Time world during [[Saven]] [[Saven 22|22]] to [[Amadaine]] [[Amadaine 22|22]].  [[Sunday]] occurs on the 21st of June.
